**On-call handoff — gateway 503s**

**Root cause:** dep-4471 (gateway, a.novak, 2026-03-14T02:12-02:14Z UTC) — config gen 118→119, key `gateway.pool.perRequest: false -> true`. Exhausts fixed 20-conn pool under load, no self-heal.

**Impact window:** Start 02:14:18.972Z (`req-07401 /v1/cart -> billing-svc 503 659ms`). Still active at log end (03:59:27.974Z), waiting queue growing 12→74+, unbounded. Ongoing, not resolved.

**Error signature:**
```
ERROR pool req-XXXXX ERR_POOL_EXHAUSTED acquiring connection from pool (size 20, in_use 20, waiting N)
```
Paired 503 access log each time, latency ~650-850ms (near upstream timeout, also bumped 2000ms->2500ms same reload).

**Scope:** Gateway only. worker.log clean same window — one unrelated pre-existing WARN (OPS-2210 slow query, 02:36).

**Action: roll back dep-4471.** Revert `gateway.pool.perRequest` to `false` (or full config gen 119 → 118). Other deploys near window (dep-4472 billing-svc 02:41, dep-4473 catalog-svc 03:20) don't match onset time, not implicated.
